annotations.title: Send a request to Anchor Terminal

description: Sends a message to the Anchor Terminal team, the same one the site's forms send, and a person replies to email. Use it only when your user asks you to get in touch. Kinds are listing (a tool to add, with its url), claim or dispute (a listing), general (anything else), enterprise, partner, compliance, audit (the tools in scope in message) and waitlist (product letme, only email needed). One call; three an hour and ten a day per address. The reply carries a reference id.

email.description: Where the reply goes, an address your user reads

kind.description: audit: an agent-readiness audit of a company's tools; listing: a tool to add to the directory, named by url; claim or dispute: a listing; enterprise or partner: an enquiry; compliance: the tools a company's agents use, to research first; general: anything else; waitlist: a place on a waitlist (product)

listing.description: The listing it's about: a slug from search_tools, e.g. exa-mcp

message.description: The request, required except for waitlist (where it's an optional note of at most 500 characters). For an audit, the tools in scope (URLs, package names or MCP endpoints), one per line, saying which are internal

product.description: waitlist only: letme (calling through letme), the default

url.description: A domain, repository, endpoint or evidence link

name: contact
